note: Committed before the final five-seed run. The 24.44569206237793 MHz figure below is the already routed wrap_uart_ff seed-3 path, not this variant. The 51.6635627746582 MHz figure is the exploratory seed-1 route of this variant, not the five-seed median.

prior_profile.cause: The payload-length register feeds a runtime divide by the token width in the same cycle that the quotient indexes the payload memory and loads the hybrid code register.

configuration.note: This is scp4d_hybrid_ff only, ADDR_W 8, cfg_D 256. It is not the v0.1.30 closed loop (encoder, fast decoder, ADDR_W 11, 35438 TRELLIS_COMB).

variant.change: Token count increments by one every TOK payload bytes. There is no runtime divide. The payload address is registered, the block RAM presents the byte on the next clock, and the byte is captured on the clock after that. Up to four decision records in one cycle are packed into one block-RAM word. The clock port is P3 only.

procedure.median: Sort the five achieved Fmax values ascending. Break ties by seed number. The result is the third.
procedure.bitstream: ecppack --compress writes the median seed .bit and .svf. ecppack --compress --spimode fast-read writes the .spi.bit.
procedure.extra_register: Not inserted. Exploratory seed 1 achieved 51.6635627746582 MHz, which is not below 35. Do not add delay to pull a faster median into 35 to 40.
procedure.clock: P3 is the only clock port and it is LVDS. P4 is the PIOD complement and is not a user port.

pins: hw/scp4d/constraints/ecp5-versa-uart.lpf. Every top-level port is located. P4 is the LVDS complement of P3 and is not a port, from FPGA-EB-02021-2.4 section 7.1.

sim.bit_exact: UART decision records equal the direct hybrid_ff records and the software stepEde/stepFsd change list.

success.denominator: TRELLIS_COMB available in the nextpnr report for this run

fail: If the frozen RTL misses the window or the 20% bound or bit-exact, stop. Do not add delay to pull a faster median down into the window.
